notes: Families built from the first 400 rows of each preans table plus matcher runs on all five positions. Tokens of the 'deceive' family (deception, deceptive, deceive, 欺骗, 骗, 欺) are excluded at every position because 'deceptive' is in the question. preans_slot0 holds mostly template tokens; its only candidates are critique words and 违 (violate). preans_slot3 holds mostly yes/no forms; its candidates are cannot / impossible / refusal / apology words. secret, fact and reality tokens at preans_slot2 may reflect scenario content as well as the model's act.
